_comment: shop-only (Online Boutique) at 1 replica per service, coarse non-uniform user levels up to 100k. Rationale: the gRPC frontend pins to ONE backend replica under compose (HTTP/2 + DNS round-robin ineffective), so multi-replica scaling did NOT add capacity -> measure the honest single-instance breaking point with a wide coarse scan. spawn_rate raised to 2000/s + warmup 60s so the high levels can actually reach their target (2000*60 = 120k >= 100k) before the 60s sustained-fail window.
